effect.en: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.

flavor.ko: 비늘을 쏘아서 공격한다. 2-5회 동안 연속으로 쓴다. 스피드가 올라가지만 방어가 떨어진다.
flavor.en: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
